verdict.rationale: Factory documents several ways to run work in the background without supervision. Headless `droid exec` runs in CI/CD, scripts and batch jobs with tiered autonomy, and `droid exec --mission` launches multi-agent Missions. Droid also picks up assigned Linear or Jira issues on its own, posts automated PR review in CI, and Software Factory offers "persistent automations" that put code review, QA and docs "on autopilot," running on stateful Droid Computers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled or cron-style triggers and how persistent automations are configured, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
